title: ASK UNK — Focused Card Viewer
summary: Choose Yamal, Haaland, or Messi, then drag the card through the 498×498 canvas to reveal its back or change its orientation.

blocks.content:
This experiment pulls the card presentation out of the ASK UNK detail screen and removes the surrounding product interface.

Choose between Yamal, Haaland, and Messi from the thumbnail rail, then explore the selected card on one dark canvas.

Drag in any direction to rotate the physical card. Use the bottom-right rotate control to switch between portrait and landscape. Orbit damping, idle motion, card depth, and a moving studio shine reproduce the ASK UNK interaction.
